summary: The candidate adds and mock-tests shared-prefix cascade for profitable eager ordinary-decode batches, but explicitly excludes CUDA-graph replay and several production modes. Its real FlashInfer integration is skipped on the prepared AMD ROCm host, so production wrapper, merge-kernel, NVIDIA serving correctness, and performance claims remain unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: 11 failed, 2 passed, 1 skipped because the base lacks cascade selection, metadata, updater, and forward behavior.
Candidate focused regression: 6 passed, 1 skipped, 7 subtests passed. The GPU float64 merge identity ran; the real FlashInfer integration test skipped.
Independent confirmation that graph replay uses ordinary decode, excluded modes remain excluded, prefix boundary behavior, and an identical-request batch produces zero-length unique KV segments.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X was used. Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 reported HIP 7.2.26015 and torch.version.cuda=None. The portable float64 numerical identity ran on GPU; no NVIDIA FlashInfer kernel executed.

remaining_counterexamples: CUDA-graph decode always updates and replays the existing ordinary decode wrappers; cascade is eager-only.
Sliding-window attention, encoder-decoder cross attention, speculative decode, and dequant-workspace KV caches do not use cascade.
A profitable all-identical batch invokes the unique FlashInfer wrapper with one zero-length KV segment per request; real-kernel behavior is unverified.
Actual BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper.forward_return_lse and production merge-state kernel execution is unverified because the integration test skipped.
No NVIDIA serving benchmark or end-to-end shared-prefix request workload verifies serving correctness or latency/throughput benefit.
remaining_limitations: The prepared architecture is AMD ROCm rather than NVIDIA CUDA.
FlashInfer is not installed and torch.version.cuda is null.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot exercise the CUDA-only FlashInfer backend and would not qualify this feature.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
